SAP Enterprise Platform

SAP BTP

SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) is an integrated offering from SAP that brings together database and data management, application development and integration, analytics, and intelligent technologies to help businesses innovate, integrate, and scale efficiently, supporting their digital transformation journey with a robust, flexible technology foundation.

Capabilities

Built around the way your business works.

Explore the business capabilities that help organisations simplify operations, improve visibility and create sustainable growth.

  1. 1

    Database and Data Management

    SAP HANA in-memory database, SAP Data Intelligence for data orchestration, and SAP Data Warehouse Cloud for unified data warehousing.

  2. 2

    Application Developments

    Custom application development and extension using SAP BTP, SAP Extension Suite, APIs, cloud-native technologies, and integration services to build scalable enterprise applications.

  3. 3

    Analytics

    SAP Analytics Cloud for BI, planning, and predictive analytics, plus a unified data access layer via SAP Data Warehouse Cloud.

  4. 4

    Intelligent Technologies

    SAP AI Core for machine learning and AI, and IoT connectivity for physical-asset data collection and analysis.

  5. 5

    Business Services

    Pre-built business logic and integrations that facilitate faster development and deployment of applications.
